rationale: The description provides provider, certification and support-status context for COBOL compilers, not compiler functionality.
evidence_spans: Oracle is the exclusive provider of Micro Focus COBOL compilers for PeopleSoft applications. With our certification of the new Visual COBOL compiler last year, Oracle had announced that the Server Express and Net Express would not be supported past December, 2020.
conflict_response: Both proposals identify provider, certification and end-of-support information rather than compiler behavior. The support-only limitation is explicit in the text, so weak forced non_ai remains.
